chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a young woman wearing an elegant emerald-green satin evening dress and a thin gold necklace.
chars.JACK: JACK: a young man wearing a light grey suit with a burgundy tie and a white shirt.
chars.BRIDE: BRIDE: a young woman wearing a big white Moroccan wedding gown with gold embroidery and a sparkling tiara.
chars.GROOM: GROOM: a man of about 30 wearing a black tuxedo with a black bow tie and a white rose on the lapel.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a luxurious Moroccan wedding hall in Casablanca with golden zellige walls and round guest tables, the BRIDE stops dead in the middle of the hall, mouth open in shock, staring at a guest table where the NARRATOR sits calmly smiling next to JACK, who waves at the bride. Comic awkward tension between them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of the BRIDE frozen in place in the Moroccan wedding hall, eyes wide, holding her gown, shocked, blurred wedding guests and golden lanterns behind her.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: At a round guest table in the Moroccan wedding hall, the angry GROOM leans over the table pointing at JACK and asking him questions, while JACK leans back calmly and the NARRATOR sits next to him sipping a glass of juice.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: At the wedding table, the NARRATOR smiles sweetly and raises one hand as if saying 'I invited him', while the GROOM stands next to her red-faced and furious, fists clenched.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan wedding hall, the BRIDE rushes up to JACK and grabs his sleeve, asking him an angry question with a suspicious jealous face, JACK looks at her silently, guests in the background turning their heads.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: The BRIDE with a red angry face walks away with JACK through a side door of the Moroccan wedding hall toward a quiet corridor, she glances back sharply, JACK leads the way.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: The GROOM sits alone on the decorated bride-and-groom throne (amaria-style gold seats) at the wedding, forcing an awkward fake smile, sweating, very uncomfortable, while guests clap around him.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Wide view of the joyful Moroccan wedding party: guests dancing, a band playing, golden lights; the GROOM sits stiffly in the middle and the NARRATOR watches from her table with a satisfied smile.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan wedding hall, the bride's golden throne seat is EMPTY, the GROOM stands next to it looking around nervously at his watch, wedding guests whisper to each other and point at the empty seat.
